text:
sasha: Quick sync — final announce cadence for Wed. We need: changelog link, docs link (examples), canary timing, and inbound lead routing by EOD. Press embargo 10:00 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout windows? @ryan
ryan: On it. I have a canary plan draft, ETA 15:00 UTC for the full doc. Thinking: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 40m -> full if metrics look good. Any region constraints?
elena: Docs PR ready (PR #124). Preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/124. I still need the final changelog entry to reference.
sasha: Perfect — marketing will use that preview for the blog and webinar slides. Once changelog link is up, we need it pinned in the announcement and the repo.
ryan: Region target: US + EU primary, APAC starts after full rollout. Autoscale on for the canary. If latency > 300ms or error rate > 1% we abort. I'll post the canary plan and a short rollback checklist.
tom: That ramp looks good. Ops note: set alert for 5xx spike + latency threshold and make rollback manual-first.
ops-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by ryan for 2026-03-25T16:20:00Z
ryan: Scheduling deploy for 16:20 UTC. Changelog diff will be posted here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/abc123 (working on the human-friendly blurb).
sasha: Marketing timeline: blog goes live 17:15 UTC; social posts at +15/+60 mins; webinar CTA in the blog (registration link below). Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-inference
elena: I've added the quickstart snippets and an embeddings example to the preview. Will update code sample with the final model name and params once ryan confirms.
sasha: For inbound leads — use the "launch" tag in HubSpot. Routing: leads -> Marketing SDR queue, then Tier 1 if usage > 50 reqs/day. @tom please confirm routing flow.
tom: Confirmed. Flow: Leads with tag=launch -> hubspot/queue/marketing-sdr. Tiered rules: usage>50 -> SDR-high, otherwise SDR-medium. I'll paste the rule IDs into the internal ops doc after this thread.
sasha: Can we run a 15m dry-run before publish? Quick go/no-go check and webinar pitch rehearse.
ryan: I can do 16:50 UTC for a 15m prep. I'll bring a short checklist: canary health, logs, and rollback steps.
elena: I'll be there to demo docs and the quickstart snippet.
sasha: Awesome. I'll post final links and the embargo reminder in #marketing 30m before publish. :rocket:
